signal: All confirmed_state transitions for the frozen 11 sectors after baseline, including unfavorable states and every repeat transition; no post-hoc selection
entry: A-grade state transition is recorded in one committed daily run; eligibility is confirmed on a later daily run. Entry is the first SPY trading close strictly after both signal as_of and that later confirmation date in America/New_York. Missing ETF price stays missing; never shift entry.
price_source: Yahoo Finance adjusted Close via yfinance auto_adjust=True; sector ETF proxy versus SPY, not original equal-weight constituent basket
metric: ETF absolute return, ETF minus SPY percentage-point excess, minimum intraperiod excess including zero
missing: No forward fill or date shifting; missing ETF entry or any horizon price is reported missing; all state transitions remain counted
costs: Gross adjusted-close research proxy; no trading costs; not an executable strategy or selection rule
preprotocol_history: 2026-09-25 through 2026-10-09 A snapshots are baseline/context only, not prospective events because they lack independent publication timestamps
historical_replay: C-quality backtest remains separate and not validated
